description: Three implementation instances of the single canonical method; not three new canonical profiles.

instances.subject: STAMP/STPA
instances.challenge: Safe maintenance decision with admitted critical-supply continuity
instances.evidence: four-step analyst model and executed finite discrete control/feedback cases
instances.route_model: I/M/P/incomplete; explicitly admitted deferment is M
instances.horizon: one executed decision/actuator-feedback cycle; full numerical timing and maintained-control duration are unscored
instances.cost: abstract model query/command/feedback counts; engineering/sensor/operating costs unscored

instances.subject: SPIFFE
instances.challenge: Authenticate intended workload and qualify a legitimate batch operation
instances.evidence: own RS256/JWT-SVID selected-profile code with actual cryptography; no SPIRE/Workload API
instances.horizon: frozen validation clock and token validity predicates; network/application response time unscored
instances.cost: actual signature verification/policy calls; setup/source/transport/staffing costs not priced
instances.risk_effectiveness: per-case outcomes; designed negative-heavy vectors are not population rates

instances.subject: RATS
instances.challenge: Qualified consumption of appraised software-state evidence for a receiving operation
instances.evidence: actual local file hashes and JWS with synthetic trusted role/source profile; no hardware/native verifier product
instances.horizon: frozen appraisal/result validity clock; no physical/distributed atomicity or calibrated end-to-end timing
instances.cost: actual hash reads/signature checks/policy calls; production acquisition/trust/maintenance unscored
instances.risk_effectiveness: per-case outcomes; current-file source trust is an explicit local assumption

common.correspondence: declared realization; operational isomorphism and inherited R01 bounds not established
common.business_value: illustrative process objectives; deployment-owner interpretation/calibration pending
common.matched_external_peer: not executed; competent native/conventional policy receives full credit
common.independence: same author; no external expert/provider validation
